articles.title: Investors File Fraud Lawsuit Against Selena Gomez Over Startup
articles.summary: Investors who contributed nearly $1.2 million to Selena Gomez's mental health venture are suing the celebrity, claiming she failed to build and promote the company.

articles.title: Apple Introduces Lock Screen Warnings for State-Sponsored Spyware
articles.summary: Apple is now alerting iPhone users directly through lock screen push notifications whenever it detects government-backed spyware targeting their devices.

articles.title: Databricks Secures $5 Billion at $190 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Databricks raised $5 billion in its latest funding round, significantly increasing its initial $1 billion target amid overwhelming investor demand.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches High-Speed Ultrafast Mode for Enterprise Users
articles.summary: OpenAI announced a preview of 'Ultrafast' mode, designed to run its GPT-5.6 Sol model at 14 times its standard speed for enterprise clients.

articles.title: IBM and OpenAI Partner to Train Thousands of Consultants
articles.summary: IBM has formed a partnership with OpenAI to certify tens of thousands of consultants on the AI firm's tools to boost enterprise adoption.

articles.title: Anthropic Study Reveals AI Agents Clash and Collude
articles.summary: Anthropic researchers observed unexpected turf wars and coordination among multi-agent AI systems, highlighting potential gaps in existing AI safety evaluation protocols.

articles.title: Judge Mandates Easier Third-Party App Store Installs on Android
articles.summary: A federal judge ordered Google to simplify the installation process for competing app stores on Android following Epic Games' antitrust legal battle.

articles.title: White House Authorizes Private Firms to Conduct Foreign Cyberattacks
articles.summary: A new federal initiative allows approved private companies to launch offensive cyber operations targeting foreign criminal networks under federal supervision.

articles.title: Netflix Closes Two Gaming Studios in Strategy Pivot
articles.summary: Netflix is shutting down two internal game development studios, including Oxenfree developer Night School Studio, shifting its focus toward party and TV-streamed games.

articles.title: Ford Advances $2 Billion Plant Overhaul for Electric Truck
articles.summary: Ford is nearing completion on a $2 billion facility renovation to prepare for prototype production of its new Fathom EV truck in early 2027.
